bio.text: Brandon Gill represents Texas's 26th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, to which he was elected in 2024.
He was born on a military air force base and raised on a cattle ranch in West Texas.
He holds degrees in economics and history from Dartmouth College and worked in finance as an investment banker and hedge fund analyst before starting a media business.
He lives in Flower Mound, Texas, with his wife and two children.
